```{r} 
#set up
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

```
```{r}

# Import raw PISA data
pisa_raw <- read_sav(
  "../data/raw/CY09_MS_STU_PUF.sav",
  col_select = c(
    Option_ICTQ,
    ST004D01T, # gender
    MALE, 
    CNT,
    ICTRES,
    AIUSESCH,
    ICTSCH,
    ICTHOME,
    ICTQUAL,
    ICTFEED,
    ICTOUT,
    ICTWKDY,
    ICTWKEND,
    DIGINTLRN,
    INTICT,
    ICTAVHOME,
    ICTAVSCH,
    ICTINFO,
    ESCS,
    W_FSTUWT,
    starts_with("W_FSTURWT"),
    starts_with("PV") & matches("^(PV[1-9]|PV10)(SCIE|MATH|READ|CMPS|CPPK|CMOD|CPRO)$")
  )
)

# Basic inspection
dim(pisa_raw)
names(pisa_raw)[1:50]
glimpse(pisa_raw)
```
```{r}
# ICT questionnairs are not delivered in certain countries (Option_ICTQ == 0), so we filter out these countries
pisa_clean <- pisa_raw %>%
  filter(Option_ICTQ == 1)

nrow(pisa_clean)

nrow(pisa_clean)/nrow(pisa_raw)
# 48% of all students are delivered the ICT questionnaire
glimpse(pisa_clean)

```

```{r}
# export

dir.create("/Users/luna/Desktop/GlobalED/data/processed", showWarnings = FALSE)

data.table::fwrite(
  pisa_clean,
  file = "/Users/luna/Desktop/GlobalED/data/processed/pisa_clean.csv"
)
```
